facts.fact: Burundi's Senate voted unanimously to ratify the EAC protocol on Regional Digital Integration; the article is dated 2025-01-21 and gives no vote date, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: EAC protocol on Regional Digital Integration

facts.fact: Burundi formally entered the EAC One Network Area on 1 August 2024, with new regulations from its regulator cutting regional roaming tariffs, so calls and data roaming with five other countries are treated as domestic rates.
